items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: Well, I was playing bass with the same band, Professor Holmes.

ctx.x: I thought that was his last name one time.
Yeah. Mm-hmm. Oh, you want to know something about Holmes? Oh, yes.

items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: He taught me. I was playing in his band.

ctx.x: The clarinet. The clarinet. And who are the two cornet players?
Joe Poehler. You had one arm huh? One arm.
